recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖而非形態影像：多條染色體呈三套（如 5、7、9、15、19）且 21 號有四條，總數約 57–59 條，屬高雙倍體（hyperdiploid）；1、8、10、16 號旁附有標示結構異常的示意圖，與骨髓瘤常見的奇數染色體三體及 1 號染色體異常相符。
features: G-banded karyogram, not a morphologic image; resolution limits band-level assessment
Hyperdiploid chromosome count (approximately 57-59 on visual count)
Trisomies of several odd-numbered chromosomes (5, 7, 9, 15, 19) and four copies of chromosome 21, typical of hyperdiploid myeloma
Extra copies of additional chromosomes including 2, 6, 12, 16 and 17; single chromosome 22
Ideograms flag structurally abnormal homologs of chromosomes 1, 8, 10 and 16; the marker slot is empty
describe_en: This figure is a G-banded karyogram from a plasma cell myeloma bone marrow sample rather than a morphologic image. Visual count shows a hyperdiploid clone of roughly 57-59 chromosomes with trisomies of odd-numbered chromosomes (including 5, 7, 9, 15 and 19), tetrasomy 21, additional gains of chromosomes such as 2, 6, 12 and 17, and structural abnormalities highlighted by ideograms on chromosomes 1, 8, 10 and 16. The chromosome 1 rearrangement corresponds to the reported 1q gain with 1p deletion. The exact karyotype cannot be verified at this resolution, but the pattern is consistent with a complex hyperdiploid myeloma karyotype with high-risk chromosome 1 abnormalities, confirmed by FISH.

ddx.vs: Non-hyperdiploid myeloma typically shows a near-diploid or hypodiploid karyotype with IGH translocations such as t(4;14), t(11;14) or t(14;16), which FISH did not detect in this case.

High hyperdiploid B-ALL shows gains of chromosomes X, 4, 6, 10, 14, 17, 18 and 21 in children, whereas myeloma hyperdiploidy favors odd chromosomes 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 15, 19 and 21 in a plasma cell neoplasm.
